dialogs.title: Event editor
dialogs.text:
Event editor
done
Got it
Required event details

Complete the fields needed for saving.

Name, description, minimum and maximum capacity, start time, and end time are required. The image and location are optional; use the header checkmark to save.

Visibility and joining

Choose who can find the event and what joining requires.

Public, Friends only, and Invitation only control discovery. The Open/Blind setting decides whether attendees can see each other before the event; you can also choose up to five topics and enable automatic invitations, ticketing, or approval.

Schedule, price, and rules

Set when the event runs and any joining conditions.

Choose a one-time or repeating schedule and adjust its time slots when needed. Pricing and event policies are optional, and the location field sets the place shown for the event.

Sub-events

Split a larger event into smaller parts.

Sub-events can be mandatory parts or optional choices with their own capacity and price. Casual keeps a simple structure, while Tournament adds stages, groups, scores, and standings.

Members and roles

Manage participants in a separate member window.

Open Members to invite people and review accepted or pending participants. Available role and status actions depend on whether you are an organizer, manager, or member.

Resources

Assign people and assets to an event part.

From a sub-event or group, open members, transport, accommodation, or supplies. Assign uses an asset you already manage, while Explore finds one you can request.
